data.name: Prolific Mindset
data.detailed_description:
Join Our Discord


About the Game

Sunday night again.

Same list. Same quiet dread. Same promise that Monday is the start of something new.

By Wednesday, the tabs are left open. The plan is paused. The books are still stacked exactly where you left them. The loop continues. ​

Prolific Mindset is where the loop breaks. ​

Step into a cozy, first-person life simulation built around the parts of life you actually want to get good at. Escape the pressure of the real-world grind and build your ideal routine across wealth, health, leisure, and intentional living. ​

Key Features ​

Your Cozy Productivity Haven:

Your space, your pace. Decorate your dream environment, tend to your plants, and unwind with your loyal pet companion. This is a stress-free sanctuary designed to inspire your next chapter. ​ 

Interactive Life Systems:

Gamify the real world. Experiment with hands-on systems covering investing, budgeting, credit optimization, and travel hacking. Test out big ideas and discover the best strategies to apply beyond the screen. ​

Curated Wisdom:

Explore a constantly evolving, bite-sized library of wealth-building strategies, health insights, and productivity frameworks. Turn overwhelming self-help advice into actionable, engaging gameplay. ​

Community-Driven Learning:

You aren't navigating your growth in isolation. Tap into a passive, community-driven network right inside the game. Discover the actual books, daily habits, and life hacks that real players are using to transform their routines, and share your own milestones with a supportive community.

Whether you’re a cozy simulation fan seeking a game with practical rewards, or a productivity nerd looking for a stress-free way to visualize your long-term goals, *Prolific Mindset* gives you the space to breathe, learn, and step off the hamster wheel.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Headphones recommended for immersive audio experience
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Best experienced with headphones and a focused mindset
